newsitem.title: UK: Citibank sets call and put warrants.
newsitem.headline: Citibank sets call and put warrants.

text.p: Citibank NA says it has issued 58 million currency call and put warrants and 62 million American-style call and put warrants on German stocks.

The currency warrant tranches consist of 10 million warrants each. There are 44 tranches on the U.S. dollar/mark (22 tranches of calls and 22 tranches of puts), six tranches on the U.S. dollar/ yen (three tranches of calls and three tranches of puts) and eight tranches on the sterling/mark rate (four tranches of calls and four tranches of puts). There are various maturity dates.

Additionally there are two tranches of call warrants on Allianz AG Holding, five million warrants per tranche, one tranche of 20 million call warrants on AMB Aachener & Muenchener Beteiligung, one tranche of 10 million call warrants on CKAG Colonia Konzern, one tranche of five million call warrants on GEA, two tranches of call warrants on Muenchner Reinsurance, 3.5 million warrants per tranche and one tranche of 10 million call warrants on Victoria Holding. All these warrants mature June 25, 1998
